corpus.provenance: Original procedural fiction; generator in context_lab/data.py
corpus.split_policy: deduplicate exact text, seeded shuffle, 80/10/10 by document
corpus.tokenizer: UTF-8 bytes plus BOS=256 and EOS=257

protocol.selection: lowest full validation loss; test is measured after training
protocol.evaluation: document-local nonoverlapping chunks; every target counted once
protocol.comparison: equal training target budget, same width/depth/optimizer schedule
